items.title: guide skip cannot say which step it means: with checkpoints advancing by themselves, a skip sent after a read of step k lands on step k+1 if k's checkpoint passed in between, and records k+1 as attempted and not passed though the person never saw it

must_fix.evidence: Review round 1, 2026-10-31, code read: evaluate_checkpoint advances in Last, handle_guide skip acts on whatever step is current in RemoteLast. The reply's `skipped` names the step actually skipped, so the call does not lie; the damage is one wrong k/n entry. GuideRequest.skip's schema text ('Move past the current step WITHOUT its condition passing') describes skipping a checkpointed step, so the race is reachable.

items.evidence: Fix: an optional `step` (label) guard on skip, refused when it is not the current step; failing test: post a checkpointed script, make the checkpoint true, run a frame, skip with step = the first label, expect a refusal and at unchanged.
